name: Is slip-resistant flooring harder to clean than regular shower tiles?

mainEntity.name: Is slip-resistant flooring harder to clean than regular shower tiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: While slip-resistant flooring has textured surfaces to enhance grip, which can sometimes trap soap scum or mineral deposits more readily than smooth surfaces, it is not necessarily harder to clean. Regular cleaning with appropriate non-abrasive cleaners and a soft brush or sponge is usually sufficient. Some highly textured surfaces might require slightly more effort. Avoiding harsh chemicals and ensuring good ventilation can help maintain cleanliness and prevent buildup.
acceptedAnswer.description: Slip-resistant flooring may require a bit more attention to cleaning textured surfaces, but isn't inherently harder to maintain.
